title: Release Raw Scenes?
body:
Hi Zheng Yang,

Thank you for your excellent work! I noticed that you’ve released the rendered annotations of PointOdyssey, I’m wondering if it would be possible to also release the raw scenes?

Also, could you share the approximate time cost ratio between _generating the scenes_ and _rendering the annotations_?

Thanks again!

title: Clarification on Synchronized Views in the dataset
body:
Hello,

Thank you so much for making the amazing work public! I was going through the project page which mentions:

"For a subset of the scenes, we include multiple synchronized views."

I was wondering if there are more details available about which specific scenes include these synchronized views? I downloaded the sample data but couldn't find any labels, metadata, or documentation indicating whether a scene contains synchronized views or not.

Thanks in advance!

title: Multi-view Data
body: Thanks for the great work! Did you have any plans on releasing a dataset with renderings from multiple sparse views, e.g., 2 or 4 views? From what I understand, the [Blender project files](https://github.com/y-zheng18/point_odyssey/issues/7) have not been released so far, so I can't export such renderings by myself for all the dataset scenes

title: Blender project files
body:
Hi there! This work would be really useful in other domains such as [animation](https://lisiyao21.github.io/projects/AnimeRun). In this case it would be necessary to export toon rendered (line drawing) images.

Is there any plan to release the blender project files? This would enable us to export different renders. I imagine others might want to do something similar.
